takeaway: Bone is living tissue: osteoblasts lay bone, osteoclasts resorb it, immobility loses bone, and thyroxine is one of the hormones involved in remodelling.

question.text: Concerning bone physiology, which one of the following statements is true?

answer.text: Thyroxine is involved in bone remodelling.

lines.text: Bone is never finished; it is constantly remodelled.
Osteoblasts are the builders. They lay down new bone, so they do not resorb it.
Osteoclasts are the demolition crew, resorbing bone with lytic enzymes.
Hormones conduct the orchestra: parathormone, calcitonin, oestrogen, and thyroxine.
So thyroxine is involved in remodelling.
And immobility does cause bone loss, called disuse osteoporosis.
